stories.title: Guaranteed jobs scheme for young people extended to Flintshire as claimant numbers rise
stories.summary: The number of 18 to 24 year olds in Flintshire claiming unemployment-related benefits has risen by a quarter in a year, as a UK government scheme guaranteeing young people a paid job is extended to the county for the first time. stories.title: Council asked to apologise over £516,000 for schools
stories.summary: The motion says the money was restored only after an amendment was carried against the wishes of the deputy leader who proposed the original motion.
